chatMention.label: Enable chat mentions
chatMention.description: Highlights @yourname in room chat and alerts you when someone mentions you.

chatMentionCompleter.label: Enable mention completer
chatMentionCompleter.description: Typing @ in a chat suggests the names in the room, game or conversation. Use the arrow keys to choose, Enter or Tab to insert, Escape to close.

invertTextColor.label: Invert text color
invertTextColor.description: White text on the highlight color. Off uses black text.

ignoreUnregisteredUsers.label: Ignore chat room messages sent by unregistered users

ignoreUnregisteredUserMessages.label: Ignore private messages sent by unregistered users

ignoreNonBuddyUserMessages.label: Ignore private messages sent by non-buddy users

privateMessageFilter.description: Applies to new conversations only. Moderators and administrators always get through.

showMessagePopups.label: Enable desktop notifications for private messages

roomHistory.label: Enable room message history on join

ignoreAllPrivateMessages.label: Ignore all private messages
ignoreAllPrivateMessages.description: Also silences conversations you already have open. Messages from moderators and administrators still arrive.

useGameTime.label: Use game time instead of local time in game logs
useGameTime.description: Each line shows how long the game had been running when it happened.

highlightWords.label: Alert words
highlightWords.description: Separate words with a space, alphanumeric characters only.

macros.label: Messages
macros.description: Quick messages to send during a game, kept in this order.
macros.tooLong: Messages can be at most {max} characters.
